# A waitlist that grows itself, and a list you actually own.

> A free, open-source alternative to Viral Loops and Prefinery: a launch waitlist where confirmed referrals move people up the line, with fraud guards and batch invites. Clean a pasted email list and project your viral growth in your browser, then run the server in your own account.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
